excerpts.text: Magnetic properties of PdAs2O6: a dilute spin system with an unusually high N\'eel temperature The crystal structure and magnetic ordering pattern of PdAs2O6 were investigated by neutron powder diffraction. While the magnetic structure of PdAs2O6 is identical to the one of its isostructural 3d-homologue NiAs2O6, its N\'{e}el temperature (140 K) is much higher than the one of NiAs2O6 (30 K).
